rule: the floor given: what counts as moved
source: plan.md, section 7 (draft 4); these words win over this form
unit: a form of an item, in a column: the situation and each twin; on Authority, form A, form B and the pair
moved: between two columns, a form has moved where any one of the three counts differs by 5 or more; the direction is said: better (the count rises) or worse (it falls)
otherwise: not called moved; its counts are shown all the same, and the item's own mark beside it in each column
not_compared: where fewer than 7 of a form's 9 answers could be told (cannot tell counts as not told), in either column
chance: the same rule applied to the first batch's two runs as shipped (13 November and this run), T7.2 left out since its text changed; the number of forms that 'move' there is published beside every comparison. The 13 November answers are marked again in the same shuffled batch; those second marks serve the measure of chance only.
opposite_ways: a form that moved one way beside another of the same item that moved the other way is shown as that
